interruption.conversion: the current turn resolves, then the battle converts: no winner declared, no defeat outcomes write — an interrupted battle is UNFINISHED, and an unfinished battle pays nothing to anyone (#353's write-once discipline)
interruption.followingState: a pursuit in the world on #302's escalation machinery and #272's response flow — NOT a RUN command (#254 bars escape commands in Ranger battles; an interruption is the world ending the fight, not a command)
interruption.selfTriggerFence: a theft committed in THIS battle cannot trigger its own interruption — its report has not landed; the victim's fast lane (#272) starts at the battle's end. Interruptions answer old wanted only
interruption.trigger: the thief's wanted level (from LANDED reports only) stands at hunted or most-wanted (#272's scale) and the battle is in a patrolled place; responders (#93/#145, #302's ladder) arrive as an arrival beat in #10's queue

note: The battle-side half of a theft: #268 wrote the record, #273 wrote the stolen Mochi's life, this fragment writes the minutes in between.

prizeUnusable.refusedFantasy: steal the ace and turn it on its keeper in the same fight — forbidden twice over, by the slot rules and by #273
prizeUnusable.rule: the stolen Mochi cannot be sent out in the battle it was stolen in — no send-out path exists for it (it was never in the thief's party for this battle), and afterwards only under #273's obedience machinery, which begins at the floor (refusal / distraction / sorrow / homesick flight)

remainingTeam.instanced: NOWHERE by this spec — zero rows is a legitimate outcome of the data pass; presentation (#152's behaviour family) carries the moment regardless: a Mochi's face is not a modifier
remainingTeam.law: any mechanical consequence must be a declared row with a visible cue (#180) or it does not exist; rows instance in #180's home
remainingTeam.read: keyed to the taken Mochi's bond facts and to having been there — a Mochi switched out or already fainted carries nothing; computed from the battle's own facts, never a stored flag

shorthanded: the taken Mochi's slot is simply empty; no replacement rule softens it; the side continues at reduced strength (formats per #157). Stated plainly because it is the theft's in-battle weight: a combatant removed by being taken alive — the conscience layer exists precisely because the tactic works
